correctness.rationale: From the inspected signSGD update and uniform noise, the transition probability P(k->k-1)=P(xi>B-2Bk/M)=k/M for 0<=k<=M, with the complementary upward probability. States outside move deterministically toward the band, including boundary inward transitions. Detailed balance yields pi_k=2^{-M}binom(M,k), unique by irreducibility, and every move flips parity. Setting Y=k-M/2 gives E[Y'|Y]=(1-2/M)Y and E[(Y')²|Y]=(1-4/M)Y²+1. The exact second-moment recurrence, stationary E f=delta B/4, M=1 constant loss, M=2 period-two loss, and M>=3 convergence follow analytically. Independently checked the M=7 rational transition matrix against its binomial invariant and E Y²=M/4; finite code verified only representative cases, not infinity.
